name: Dai Kaiju
caption: A Japanese superstar led by his manager Dr. Dragon, who held the EWF Television Championship into the fed's last recovered broadcast, retaining it against Hulk Hurley when a third party's interference stopped the match cold.

name: Hulk Hurley
caption: The over-the-hill, mohawked member of the Hurley wrestling clan, who came up short challenging Dai Kaiju for the EWF Television Championship when a masked interloper's run-in stopped the match.

tenures.role: wrestler -- Television Championship challenger; member of the Hurley clan

name: William the Conqueror
caption: Held the EWF Intercontinental Championship into the fed's last recovered broadcast, retaining it against The Electric Youth despite losing the match by count-out.

name: "The Cavity" Christopher Monroe
caption: "The Cavity" of the EWF World Six-Man Tag Team Champions Asylum, managed by Dr. Daniel Shinn, who lost the titles to the Beijing Beauties on the fed's last recovered broadcast.

tenures.role: wrestler -- member of Asylum, EWF World Six-Man Tag Team Champions

name: "The Insurance Policy" Keith Haas
caption: "The Insurance Policy" of the EWF World Six-Man Tag Team Champions Asylum, who lost the titles to the Beijing Beauties on the fed's last recovered broadcast.

tenures.role: wrestler -- member of Asylum, EWF World Six-Man Tag Team Champions

name: "The Harvester of Eyes" Ed Mosely
caption: "The Harvester of Eyes" of the EWF World Six-Man Tag Team Champions Asylum, who absorbed most of a grueling title defense before the Beijing Beauties took the belts.

tenures.role: wrestler -- member of Asylum, EWF World Six-Man Tag Team Champions

name: "Irresistible" Ernie Chen
caption: Led the debuting Beijing Beauties, managed by "Gorgeous" Gary Chung, to the EWF World Six-Man Tag Team Championship over Asylum on the fed's last recovered broadcast.

tenures.role: wrestler -- member of the Beijing Beauties, EWF World Six-Man Tag Team Champions (1 reign)

name: "Wondrous" Eddie Wong
caption: A debuting member of the Beijing Beauties who scored the pin ending Asylum's EWF World Six-Man Tag Team title reign.

tenures.role: wrestler -- member of the Beijing Beauties, EWF World Six-Man Tag Team Champions (1 reign)

name: "Ravishing" Richie Lee
caption: A debuting member of the Beijing Beauties who took most of the Harvester of Eyes' offense before Eddie Wong scored the fall to win the EWF World Six-Man Tag Team Championship.

tenures.role: wrestler -- member of the Beijing Beauties, EWF World Six-Man Tag Team Champions (1 reign)
